name: Komukai Chie
source:
She is a young mother with a baby. However, perhaps because she is too young, she lacks the self-awareness of a mother. For example, she leaves her son at the daycare center to go to the gym, or she doesn't want to change his diaper.

She is very sociable and can easily make friends with anyone, especially Sakura, and they sometimes go out for drinks together. 
She is friend's with Sakura's who runs a day-care center, where she takes care of her child at a friend's price.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=89041]Getchu[/url]]
